blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving including ground preparation, climb to altitude, freefall, parachute ride with control, and smooth landing. Video options include instructor wrist cam, extra flyer perspective, and gold deluxe package combining multiple video styles. Weight limits and age restrictions apply.
extraNote: Deposit required to book; fully refundable up to 48 hours before scheduled time · Deposit non-refundable if no show or cancellation less than 48 hours before · Reservations can be changed up to 5pm day before booked date subject to availability · Weather dependent; delays or reschedules possible with deposit transferred to new date
